claims: Starting in 2026, Mariners games are no longer on ROOT Sports.
Starting in 2026, Mariners games have moved to Mariners TV.
Mariners TV is produced by MLB.
In-market fans can watch Mariners games via Fubo.
In-market fans can watch Mariners games via DIRECTV.
In-market fans can watch Mariners games via Xfinity.
In-market fans can watch Mariners games via Spectrum.
In-market fans can stream Mariners games directly via Mariners.TV.
Mariners.TV costs $99.99 per season.
Mariners.TV costs $19.99 per month.
Mariners TV (In-Market) covers Washington.
Mariners TV (In-Market) covers Idaho.
Mariners TV (In-Market) covers Oregon.
Mariners TV (In-Market) covers Montana.
Mariners TV (In-Market) covers Alaska.
Mariners TV (In-Market) covers Hawaii.
Mariners TV (In-Market) covers parts of Canada.
Mariners TV is available on Xfinity channel 1261.
Mariners TV is available on Spectrum channel 414 in the Seattle area.
Mariners.TV offers a direct-to-consumer streaming option without local blackouts.
MLB.TV remains the primary option for watching Mariners games outside the Mariners' designated territory.
All Mariners games can be heard on 710 AM Seattle Sports.
All Mariners games can be heard via the Seattle Sports app.
The new Mariners TV channel is primarily active during game times including pre-game and post-game.
National broadcasts on FOX will still require the FOX channel.
National broadcasts on ESPN will still require the ESPN channel
